name: @activepieces/piece-chat-aid
description: AI-powered assistant for your knowledge base.

auth.description: Generate your API key in the dashboard: https://app.chataid.com/settings/automations

addCustomSources.name: addCustomSources
addCustomSources.description: Upload one or more files as custom sources for training

files.description: One or more files to upload (PDF, Word, Text, Markdown, HTML, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint, PNG, JPEG, GIF)

aiMetadata.description: Upload one or more files (PDF, Word, text, Markdown, HTML, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint, or images) to a Chat Aid knowledge base as custom sources for training, optionally scoped to a specific team (defaults to org-wide). Use this to ingest new documents the assistant should be able to answer from. Not idempotent: each call appends new sources, so repeating it uploads duplicates.

askQuestions.name: askQuestions
askQuestions.description: Query your Chat Aid knowledge base and receive AI-generated answers with source citations

prompt.description: The question to ask the knowledge base

parentTs.description: Optional Unix timestamp for conversation threading. Use the same value for related questions in a conversation.

messageTs.description: Optional Unix timestamp of current message. Use with parentTs for follow-up questions in a conversation.

aiMetadata.description: Ask a natural-language question against the Chat Aid knowledge base and get back an AI-generated answer with source citations; the call submits the prompt then polls until the answer is ready (timing out after ~2 minutes). Optionally pass parent and message timestamps to thread follow-up questions within an ongoing conversation. Use this to retrieve answers grounded in ingested sources. Not idempotent: each call generates a fresh completion and conversation turn.

getCustomSourceById.name: getCustomSourceById
getCustomSourceById.description: Retrieve single source details by ID

sourceId.description: The ID of the custom source to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the details of a single custom source in the Chat Aid knowledge base by its source ID. Use this to look up or verify a specific source you already have an ID for. Idempotent read-only lookup.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Generate your API key in the dashboard: https://app.chataid.com/settings/automations

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Generate your API key in the dashboard: https://app.chataid.com/settings/automations

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
